The label and entry bounding boxes MUST NOT INTERSECT; the text entry box should only include the area where data should be entered. Usually this area will be immediately to the side, above, or below its label. Entry bounding boxes must be tall and wide enough to contain their text.\n\nThese are some examples of form structures that you might see:\n\n*Label inside box*\n```\n┌────────────────────────┐\n│ Name:                  │\n└────────────────────────┘\n```\nThe input area should be to the right of the \"Name\" label and extend to the edge of the box.\n\n*Label before line*\n```\nEmail: _______________________\n```\nThe input area should be above the line and include its entire width.\n\n*Label under line*\n```\n_________________________\nName\n```\nThe input area should be above the line and include the entire width of the line.
